map.化妆品安全合规风险评估清单，对照法规要求逐项检查产品合规性: A cosmetic safety compliance risk assessment checklist that checks each requirement against regulation
map.特殊化妆品（祛斑/防晒/染发等）: Special cosmetics (whitening, sunscreen, hair dye, etc.)
map.逐项选择合规状态，系统自动计算合规评分与风险等级: Set the compliance status of each item and the system automatically computes the compliance score and risk level
map.参考《化妆品监督管理条例》《化妆品安全技术规范》等法规: Based on the Cosmetics Supervision and Administration Regulation and the Cosmetic Safety Technical Standard
map.符合=2分，部分符合=1分，不符合=0分，不适用=2分: Compliant = 2 points, partially compliant = 1 point, non-compliant = 0 points, not applicable = 2 points
map.结果仅供参考，正式合规评估需由专业机构完成: Results are for reference only; formal compliance assessment must be carried out by a qualified institution
map.📚 深度解析：化妆品合规风险评估: 📚 In-depth analysis: cosmetic compliance risk assessment
map.新品备案前逐项核对成分是否在《化妆品安全技术规范》禁用/限用清单。: Before filing a new product, check item by item whether each ingredient appears on the prohibited or restricted lists of the Cosmetic Safety Technical Standard.
map.进口化妆品核查标签、功效宣称是否有依据，避免违规宣传。: For imported cosmetics, verify the labelling and whether efficacy claims are substantiated, to avoid non-compliant advertising.
map.代工厂为品牌方做合规自查，输出风险等级与整改清单。: Contract manufacturers run a compliance self-check for brands and deliver a risk level together with a remediation list.
map.设成分安全 40 分、标签合规 30 分、功效依据 20 分、生产资质 10 分: Set ingredient safety at 40, labelling compliance at 30, efficacy substantiation at 20 and production qualification at 10 (100 points each). The weighted risk score = 40×0.4 + 30×0.3 + 20×0.2 + 10×0.1 = 30 points. Under the bands 0-30 low risk, 31-60 medium risk and 61-100 high risk, this case is low risk but the efficacy substantiation documents are still missing.
map.能替代官方备案审核吗？: Can this replace the official filing review?
map.不能。本工具是备案前的自查辅助，依据《化妆品监督管理条例》及安全技术规范做初步筛: No. This tool is a pre-filing self-check that screens against the Cosmetics Supervision and Administration Regulation and the safety technical standard. The regulator's review conclusion is what finally counts.
map.哪些项目最容易被判高风险？: Which items are most likely to be judged high risk?
map.禁用成分检出、功效宣称无科学依据、特殊化妆品未取得注册证，这三类通常会直接判高风: Detected prohibited ingredients, efficacy claims without scientific support, and special cosmetics without a registration certificate are the three that are normally judged high risk and require immediate remediation.
map.化妆品安全合规风险评估工具，对照《化妆品监督管理条例》《化妆品安全技术规范》等法: A cosmetic safety compliance risk assessment tool that checks product filing, ingredient compliance, test reports and labelling against the Cosmetics Supervision and Administration Regulation, the Cosmetic Safety Technical Standard and related requirements item by item, then outputs a compliance score and risk level.
map.加权评分，突出高风险项: Weighted scoring that highlights high-risk items
map.自动列出需整改问题: Automatically lists the issues that need remediation
